description.content:
The ProcessMaker Platform RESTful API provides programmatic access to all platform functionality including process design, case management, task handling, user management, and enterprise integrations. The API is BPMN 2.0 compliant and follows the OpenAPI specification with interactive Swagger UI documentation auto-generated by Swagger/L5-Swagger.
